boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Hillsdale College
boards.description: A practical circuit of campus spaces, food counters, restaurants, and stores offering verified evening access in and around Hillsdale.

cards.entity_name: William L. and Berniece E. Grewcock Student Union
cards.title: The 2 A.M. Campus Living Room
cards.subtitle: A school-year gathering place at the center of campus
cards.notes: Head to 16 E. Galloway Drive for lounges, games, and study space; confirm the school-year schedule during breaks or summer.
cards.short_summary: Hillsdale’s central student-life building remains accessible well beyond evening classes during the school year.
cards.evidence_claim: Hillsdale College identifies the Grewcock Student Union as a campus gathering place and lists school-year hours of 6:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: The William L. and Berniece E. Grewcock Student Union
cards.access_notes: Open Sunday–Saturday from 6:00 a.m. to 2:00 a.m. during the school year; summer hours are Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m.

cards.title: Coffee and Grab-and-Go Until Ten
cards.subtitle: The Student Union’s evening café counter
cards.notes: Use the café for coffee or grab-and-go food before 10 p.m.; check the ordering app for current selection before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A.J.’s extends campus food access into the evening every day without requiring a trip off campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The current Hillsdale College catalog lists A.J.’s Café 1844 as open until 10:00 p.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Monday–Friday: 7:30 a.m.–10:00 p.m.; Saturday–Sunday: 8:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m. The weekday kitchen opens at 8:00 a.m.

cards.title: The Campus 24-Hour Food Stop
cards.subtitle: An always-open counter inside the Dow Center
cards.notes: Check the Dow Center counter when other campus kitchens are closed; bring a payment method or eligible meal-plan credit.
cards.short_summary: This named campus food counter supplies the board’s only officially documented round-the-clock option.
cards.evidence_claim: The current Hillsdale College catalog identifies the Dow Center Grab ’N’ Go, formerly the Old Snack Bar, as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours Monday through Sunday, according to the current Hillsdale College catalog food-service page.

cards.title: Carleton Road’s Latest Drive-Through
cards.subtitle: A west-side food run operating into the early morning
cards.notes: Use the drive-through because the official page lists no dine-in schedule; check Saturday status before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: This Taco Bell provides Hillsdale’s latest officially posted restaurant service on most nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official location page lists drive-through service until 3:00 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 4:00 a.m. Thursday–Friday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Hillsdale, MI — 3011 W Carleton Road
cards.access_notes: Drive-through: Sunday–Wednesday, 9:00 a.m.–3:00 a.m.; Thursday–Friday, 9:00 a.m.–4:00 a.m. The page currently lists Saturday as closed.

cards.title: A 1 A.M. Restaurant Window
cards.subtitle: Daily late food service west of downtown
cards.notes: Choose the restaurant or drive-through before 1 a.m.; verify holiday hours on the location page before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: Wendy’s offers the same late closing time every night, making its schedule unusually easy to remember.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official Hillsdale page lists both restaurant and drive-through hours ending at 1:00 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-through close at 1:00 a.m. daily; opening is 7:00 a.m. Monday–Friday and 7:30 a.m. Saturday–Sunday.

cards.title: The 11 P.M. Pizza Pickup
cards.subtitle: Weekend carryout and delivery on West Carleton Road
cards.notes: Place Friday or Saturday orders before the 11 p.m. delivery and carryout cutoff; dine-in closes thirty minutes earlier.
cards.short_summary: Pizza Hut stretches its delivery and carryout schedule later on Friday and Saturday than on weeknights.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut’s official Hillsdale page lists Friday and Saturday delivery and carryout until 11:00 p.m., with dine-in until 10:30 p.m.
cards.source_title: Delivery Near Me — Hillsdale, MI, 508 W Carleton Rd
cards.access_notes: Friday–Saturday: delivery and carryout until 11:00 p.m.; dine-in until 10:30 p.m. Sunday–Thursday service ends earlier.

cards.title: The Friday-and-Saturday Ten O’Clock Pie
cards.subtitle: Weekend pizza service at 3883 W. Carleton Road
cards.notes: Reserve this run for Friday or Saturday, when the Hillsdale shop stays open until 10 p.m.; other nights close earlier.
cards.short_summary: Cottage Inn adds a locally situated pizza option to the late-weekend Carleton Road circuit.
cards.evidence_claim: Cottage Inn’s official Hillsdale location page lists Friday and Saturday hours ending at 10:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Friday–Saturday: open until 10:00 p.m. Sunday closes at 9:00 p.m.; Monday–Thursday also close at 9:00 p.m.

cards.title: The Midnight Grocery Sweep
cards.subtitle: A full-size store at 3600 W. Carleton Road
cards.notes: Use the late window for groceries, prepared foods, or forgotten supplies; confirm department counters separately from store hours.
cards.short_summary: The Hillsdale Meijer broadens a late run beyond restaurant food to groceries and everyday supplies.
cards.evidence_claim: Meijer’s official store page identifies the Hillsdale location at 3600 W. Carleton Road and its current store schedule runs until midnight daily.
cards.access_notes: The store is open daily from 6:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m.; individual deli, pharmacy, pickup, and other department hours may differ.

cards.title: Groceries Until Ten
cards.subtitle: A compact late errand at 290 W. Carleton Road
cards.notes: Stop before 10 p.m. for groceries or household basics; do not rely on the pharmacy, which follows a separate earlier schedule.
cards.short_summary: Kroger supplies a close-to-downtown evening grocery option with the same closing time all week.
cards.evidence_claim: Kroger’s official Hillsdale store page lists grocery-store hours of 6:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m. Sunday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Kroger Hillsdale Grocery Pickup — 290 W Carleton Rd
cards.access_notes: The grocery store is open 6:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m. daily. Pharmacy hours are separate and end earlier.

cards.title: The Ten O’Clock Essentials Run
cards.subtitle: Store and photo service near downtown Hillsdale
cards.notes: Use the store for evening essentials before 10 p.m.; check pharmacy hours separately because that counter closes earlier.
cards.short_summary: Walgreens covers personal-care and convenience needs after many daytime campus services have ended.
cards.evidence_claim: Walgreens’ official locator identifies the Hillsdale store at 196 W. Carleton Road and lists Store & Photo service until 10:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Walgreens Pharmacies & Stores Near Hillsdale, MI
cards.access_notes: Store & Photo service is listed until 10:00 p.m.; the pharmacy follows separate hours and closes earlier.
